타이머 PWM(TIM2/TIM3, 1 kHz)으로 RGB LED의 세 색: Use timer PWM (TIM2/TIM3, 1 kHz) to set each of the RGB LED's three colors to 0–100% brightness and cycle through the color wheel.
세 PWM 채널의 듀티비 조합으로 색을 섞는다 (빛의 삼원색): Mix colors by combining the duty cycles of three PWM channels (the three primary colors of light)
공통 캐소드 RGB LED의 핀 구조를 안다: Understand the pin layout of a common-cathode RGB LED
타이머 두 개(TIM2, TIM3)의 채널을 함께 쓴다: Use channels of two timers (TIM2, TIM3) together
RGB LED와 저항 세 개: An RGB LED and three resistors
**RGB LED** 하나와 **저항** 세 개를 추가하세요. 색마다 저: Add one **RGB LED** and three **Resistors**. Each color needs its own resistor.
RGB LED의 다리: `R`, `COM`(공통, 가장 긴 다리), `G: The RGB LED's legs: `R`, `COM` (common, the longest leg), `G`, `B`. The default is **common cathode**, so connect COM to GND.
색마다 PWM 핀 → 저항 → LED: For each color: PWM pin → resistor → LED
hal-pwm-led 펌웨어가 쓰는 핀:: Pins used by the hal-pwm-led firmware:
각 핀에서 저항을 거쳐 RGB LED의 해당 다리로, COM은 GND로: Connect each pin through a resistor to the matching leg of the RGB LED, and COM to GND.
**공통 캐소드** RGB LED는 LED 세 개(R, G, B)의 캐소: A **common-cathode** RGB LED ties the cathodes of three LEDs (R, G, B) to a single COM. COM goes to GND, and each color goes through a resistor to a PWM pin.
With one resistor per color, the current of each color can be set separately.
듀티비 확인하고 채점하기: Check the duty cycle and grade
**▶ 실행**하면 색이 천천히 바뀝니다. PWM **듀티비**(한 주기: Press **▶ Run** and the color changes slowly. The PWM **duty cycle** (the fraction of each period that is HIGH) sets the brightness: in `__HAL_TIM_SET_COMPARE(&htim2, TIM_CHANNEL_2, duty)`, duty 0–1000 means 0–100%.
'파형 (프로브)' 탭에 `PB3`를 추가하면 1 kHz 펄스의 폭이 변: Add `PB3` in the 'Waveform (probe)' tab to see the width of the 1 kHz pulses change. The board's LD2 (`PA5`) brightens and dims as if breathing.
**채점**은 3초 동안 실행하며 각 핀의 듀티비와 LED 색별 밝기를: **Grade** runs for 3 seconds, measuring each pin's duty cycle and the brightness of each LED color.
**색 혼합**: 빨강 100 % + 초록 100 % = 노랑, 셋 다: **Color mixing**: red 100 % + green 100 % = yellow; all three at 100 % = white. The firmware goes around the color wheel, shifting the R·G·B duties 120° apart.
한 색만 안 켜지면 그 색의 핀(D3 R, D5 G, D6 B)과 저항을: If only one color stays dark, check that color's pin (D3 R, D5 G, D6 B) and its resistor.
R(PB3) 듀티 90% 이상인 순간: A moment with R (PB3) duty at 90% or more
R(PB3) 듀티 10% 이하인 순간: A moment with R (PB3) duty at 10% or less
공통 애노드 LED를 공통 캐소드처럼 연결 — COM이 3V3 쪽이어야: Wiring a common-anode LED like a common-cathode one — COM must go to 3V3, and the duty works in reverse (0 % is brightest).
저항 하나를 COM에 달아 세 색이 함께 씀 — 색마다 밝기가 달라집니다: Putting a single resistor on COM so the three colors share it — the colors end up with different brightness.
가변저항 세 개로 R·G·B를 따로 정하는 색 섞기 장치를 설계해 보세요: Design a color mixer that sets R·G·B separately with three potentiometers (after the ADC lessons).
